name: Burden of Infrastructure
short_description: Infrastructure is no longer a free by-product of railways. A government-funded Infrastructure building in every state must be paid for in horses, transportation and wages - and horses come from a new Horse Ranch.
patch_sensitivity_note: Verified in-game against 1.13. Keyed databases are FIRST-read-wins, so 00_boi_ files shadow individual vanilla keys and only the duplicated key is discarded (expect 22 harmless 'Duplicated key' log lines per launch). Shadowed keys: 10 railway/port PMs from 11_private_infrastructure.txt (state_infrastructure_add stripped); 6 haulage PMs from 03_mines/04_plantations/09_misc_resource (horse inputs added); 2 subsistence pasture PMs from 12_subsistence.txt (horse trickle added); 4 cavalry types from 00_land_combat_unit_types.txt (horse upkeep added). GUI type shadows (gui/01_boi_*.gui, first-read-wins per type): mobilization_widget from panel_military.gui (CMF 1.65.0's wrapping grid, loses to CMF when loaded) and military_formation_panel from military_formation_panel.gui (bulk-selection grid wrap 3 -> 2); these make the grids fit the extra horse mobilization options. Each is a full copy of vanilla plus lines tagged '# BOI:'. TWO GENERATED FILE SETS, both must be regenerated after every game patch: (a) map_data/state_regions/*.txt are 16 full-file copies that insert building_boi_horse_ranch into all 675 arable_resources lists (a rural building absent from those lists cannot be built anywhere) - regenerate with: sed -E 's/(arable_resources = \{[^}]*)\}/\1"building_boi_horse_ranch" }/' on each vanilla file; (b) common/history/buildings/zz_boi_buildings.txt is the 1836 world seed - 675 Public Works, 372 Harbour Works, 236 Horse Ranches - generated by tools/gen_seed.awk and tools/curate.awk, full instructions in tools/REGENERATE.md. Horse Ranches are CURATED (core + sole owner + low industry + arable >= 25) because a state's real arable land depends on incorporation and province ownership rather than the state region's declared arable_land; seeding on the declared figure over-allocated 10 states and hard-crashed world init. History seeding is used rather than a scripted on_game_started effect because only buildings created during world initialization start STAFFED. After every game patch, re-diff all shadows and regenerate both sets.
